declaration.preface: Parekh E-Com and Warehousing Services Private Limited (PEWSPL) is committed to conducting business with integrity, transparency, and professionalism. The Company believes that ethical business practices are essential for maintaining stakeholder trust, ensuring legal compliance, and supporting sustainable growth. This Business Conduct & Ethics Policy outlines the principles and standards that guide responsible business conduct across all operations, while maintaining zero tolerance towards bribery, corruption, fraud, discrimination, harassment, and other unethical practices.
declaration.declaration:
The purpose of this policy is to identify, assess, and manage all the practices that impacts our business activities in the operational context, our leverage and business relationships. It aims to enhance the knowledge and understanding of fair practices, actions and foster attitudes of honesty, integrity, tolerance, respect, solidarity, and responsibility amongst PEWSPL employees. It is our policy to comply with all applicable anti-bribery laws where PEWSPL operates, and to reflect all transactions on PEWSPL’s books and records accurately.

The policy aims to:

Establish clear ethical standards and expectations for all employees and stakeholders.

Promote integrity, fairness, honesty, and accountability in all business operations.

Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and contractual obligations.

Prevent bribery, corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest, and unethical business conduct.

Encourage transparent communication and responsible decision-making.

Protect the rights, dignity, health, and safety of employees and stakeholders.

Strengthen stakeholder confidence and maintain PEWSPL’s reputation as a responsible logistics and supply chain service provider.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all operations of PEWSPL, including transportation activities, operational facilities, warehouses, and office locations across all locations where PEWSPL operates. It covers all permanent, temporary, and contractual employees across all functions, as well as all internal and external stakeholders associated with PEWSPL, whether directly or indirectly engaged with the organization’s operations and services.

Ethical Business Conduct: PEWSPL is committed to conducting business honestly, fairly, and responsibly while maintaining the highest standards of professional ethics and integrity.
Anti-Bribery & Anti-Corruption: The Company strictly prohibits bribery, facilitation payments, kickbacks, corruption, and improper business advantages in any form.

We are committed to maintaining zero tolerance towards bribery, corruption, facilitation payments, kickbacks, and unethical business conduct by strengthening internal controls, approval systems, and ethical compliance practices.
We strive to strengthen ethical governance, transparency, and accountability across all business operations and stakeholder interactions through regular monitoring and leadership oversight.
We will continue promoting fair and responsible business practices through awareness initiatives, compliance measures, and ethical leadership programs.
We aim to encourage employees and stakeholders to report unethical conduct or suspected corruption through confidential and accessible reporting mechanisms.
We are committed to ensuring that business decisions are made fairly, ethically, and without improper influence by implementing transparent procurement and approval procedures.
We will continue strengthening awareness regarding anti-bribery and anti-corruption requirements across the organization through periodic communication and training initiatives.

We strive to strengthen ethical governance and anti-bribery practices through internal controls, risk-based compliance monitoring, and governance frameworks aligned with applicable ISO 37001 Anti-Bribery Management System principles wherever feasible.
Compliance with Laws & Regulations: PEWSPL complies with all applicable legal, regulatory, environmental, labor, transportation, safety, and industry-specific requirements relevant to its operations.
Fair Employment Practices: The Company promotes equal opportunity, non-discrimination, respect, dignity, and fair treatment for all employees.
Data Privacy & Confidentiality: Confidential business, operational, customer, employee, and supplier information shall be protected from unauthorized disclosure, misuse, or access.
Conflict of Interest: Employees and stakeholders shall avoid situations where personal interests may conflict with Company interests or influence business decisions.
Responsible Supply Chain Practices: PEWSPL encourages ethical sourcing, responsible procurement, transparent supplier relationships, and sustainable business practices across its supply chain ecosystem.
Reporting & Whistleblower Protection: The Company encourages employees and stakeholders to report unethical behavior, fraud, policy violations, or misconduct without fear of retaliation.
AML & Financial Integrity: We are committed to conducting business only with legitimate customers, suppliers, contractors, and business partners through appropriate verification and documentation practices.
We strive to strengthen transparency, accountability, and proper documentation in financial and operational transactions by improving monitoring and approval systems.

We will continue supporting compliance with applicable anti-money laundering, legal, and regulatory requirements relevant to our operations through regular compliance reviews and awareness initiatives.
We aim to strengthen awareness regarding responsible financial practices and anti-money laundering obligations across relevant business functions through periodic training and communication programs.
We are committed to maintaining accurate financial records and transparent transaction processes by promoting responsible documentation and reporting practices.
We will continue promoting ethical financial practices and responsible business conduct throughout the organization through internal controls and governance measures.

We are committed to maintaining KYC (Know Your Customer) and vendor verification practices for customers, suppliers, contractors, and business partners through appropriate documentation and review procedures.
Information Security & Confidentiality: We are committed to protecting confidential business, customer, supplier, operational, and employee information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure through secure information handling practices and controlled access systems.
We aim to strengthen responsible information management, data privacy, cybersecurity, and record management practices across operations by improving digital controls and monitoring mechanisms.
We will continue enhancing employee awareness regarding confidentiality, responsible digital practices, and information security through periodic awareness sessions and communication programs.
We strive to promote secure handling, storage, sharing, and retention of business information and records through standardized documentation and retention procedures.
We are committed to improving responsible usage of digital systems, communication channels, and operational data by encouraging compliance with IT and cybersecurity guidelines.
We strive to strengthen information security, confidentiality, and cybersecurity practices through controls aligned with applicable ISO 27001 Information Security Management System requirements.
Conflict Management & Disclosure: We are committed to promoting fair, transparent, and objective decision-making across procurement, recruitment, vendor management, and operational activities through defined governance procedures.
We aim to strengthen processes for identifying, disclosing, and responsibly managing actual, potential, or perceived conflicts of interest through formal declaration and review mechanisms.
We will continue enhancing employee awareness regarding professional ethics, impartiality, and responsible business conduct through awareness programs and internal communication.
We strive to ensure that personal interests do not improperly influence business decisions or professional responsibilities by encouraging transparent disclosures and ethical conduct.
We are committed to encouraging timely disclosure of any conflict of interest situations that may arise during business operations through accessible reporting channels.
We will continue promoting ethical and unbiased business relationships with customers, suppliers, contractors, and other stakeholders through fair evaluation and approval practices.
Regulatory Compliance: We are committed to complying with all applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and industry-specific requirements relevant to our operations through continuous monitoring and compliance management practices.
We strive to strengthen compliance awareness and responsible business practices across all operational functions and locations through regular communication and employee engagement initiatives.
We will continue monitoring changes in applicable laws and regulations to support timely compliance and implementation through periodic reviews and updates.
We aim to promote accountability and responsible conduct in all business activities and stakeholder interactions through defined compliance procedures and governance practices.
We are committed to maintaining accurate records and documentation to support legal and regulatory compliance obligations through standardized record management systems.
We will continue enhancing employee awareness regarding compliance responsibilities and organizational expectations through periodic awareness and training programs.
Anti-Fraud Measures: We are committed to strengthening internal controls and monitoring mechanisms to prevent fraud, misconduct, and unethical activities through periodic reviews and approval systems.
We strive to maintain transparent, accurate, and accountable financial and operational practices across all business functions by promoting proper documentation and verification processes.
We will continue encouraging timely reporting of suspected fraud, unethical conduct, or policy violations through secure and accessible reporting mechanisms.
We aim to strengthen awareness regarding fraud prevention responsibilities among employees and relevant stakeholders through regular communication and awareness initiatives.
We are committed to supporting fair investigations and timely corrective actions in cases of identified misconduct or fraudulent activities through defined escalation and review procedures.
We will continue promoting a culture of honesty, accountability, and responsible business conduct throughout the organization through ethical leadership and employee engagement.
Whistleblower & Grievance Mechanism: We are committed to encouraging employees and stakeholders to report unethical conduct, fraud, harassment, corruption, or policy violations without fear of retaliation through secure and confidential reporting channels.
We strive to maintain fair, transparent, and accessible reporting and grievance handling mechanisms across the organization through defined review and escalation procedures.
We are committed to protecting confidentiality and supporting non-retaliation principles for individuals reporting concerns in good faith through ethical governance and management oversight.
We will continue strengthening trust, transparency, and accountability through responsible grievance management practices and employee engagement initiatives.
We will continue promoting awareness regarding ethical reporting channels and whistleblower protection practices through regular communication and awareness initiatives.
We aim to ensure timely review, investigation, and appropriate resolution of reported concerns and grievances through structured investigation and corrective action processes.

policy.monitoring:
Implementation of this Ethics Policy shall be monitored through periodic compliance reviews, internal assessments, employee feedback, grievance mechanisms, and monitoring of ethical concerns, incidents, and corrective actions. Reported violations and misconduct cases shall be reviewed and addressed appropriately.

PEWSPL is committed to continually improving ethical business practices through regular policy reviews, employee awareness programs, compliance monitoring, grievance management mechanisms, and implementation of corrective actions. The Company will continue strengthening its culture of integrity, transparency, accountability, and responsible business conduct.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Ethics Policy shall be reviewed annually by the Human Resources, or whenever significant changes occur in applicable laws, regulatory requirements, operational activities, or business practices, to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with the Company’s ethical commitments.
